Ava (eng-ml): Quick follow-up from the quantized-fallback postmortem: we saw repeated tail latency spikes when int8 kernels hit large context windows and the runtime fell back to fp16. Need concrete eval additions and owners.
Raj (eng-platform): I'll own the test infra side: ephemeral staging clusters + gating for the new regression. Can we define exact matrices (seq len bins, batch sizes, kernel flags)?
Mei (eng-sre): I'll take the chaos drill to reproduce memory fragmentation -> fallback. Plan: simulate gradual GPU memory pressure + random allocation failures. Target Wed 10:00am staging. Need test harness and expected alerting thresholds.
Carlos (eng-ml): I'll own regression tests + promptset. Proposed matrix: seq_lengths=[128,512,2048], batch_sizes=[1,8,32], kernels=[fp16,int8], prefix_cache=[cold,warm]. Add int8->fp16 fallback detection asserts. ETA Fri EOD.
Ava (eng-ml): Add a promptset with long-repeat and token-skew cases that historically triggered heavier KV/attention memory. Include synthetic inputs: repeated 2-3 tokens patterns and long-chain references.
Carlos (eng-ml): Example test Ill put in PR: `./tools/run_e2e.sh --model=gpt-like --seq=2048 --batch=8 --kernel=int8 --check-fallback`
Raj (eng-platform): For gating: run quick smoke on PRs (seq=128,batch=1,kernel=int8) and nightly full sweep. I'll add a new Jenkins job `regression-quant-fallback-nightly`.
Mei (eng-sre): On the chaos drill, I'll script a Jiggle that reserves 80% GPU mem, then bump to 95% over 90s to mimic fragmentation. Need the PR to include a small artifact that the drill runner can call: `scripts/induce_mem_pressure --profile=jiggle`.
Ava (eng-ml): Who will add observability checks for fallback events? We should emit a metric `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel="int8"}` and a severity rule if p95 latency increases > 25%.
Raj (eng-platform): I'll add the metric hook and alert rule. Also will add runbook links in the sheet.
Carlos (eng-ml): Action items: regression owner=Carlos (PR with tests + promptset) due Fri, chaos owner=Mei (drill Wed), infra owner=Raj (jobs + metrics) due Thu. I'll list these in the postmortem action tracker.
RunbookBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/quant-fallback  action_items: 3 assigned.
Mei (eng-sre): Quick coordination note: for the chaos drill please add a safe backstop in staging so we can abort if disk IO or infra quotas spike. Tag me on the PR.
Ava (eng-ml): Also add a regression flag for quantized kernel variations: toggles for `--rounding=nearest|stochastic` and `--qat=false|true` since quantization strategy may change memory footprint.
Carlos (eng-ml): Good call, will include rounding and qat axes in the matrix and a small README for each case.
Raj (eng-platform): I'll provision a 3-node staging with 4xA100 per node for the runs and post creds in the tracker.
Ava (eng-ml): Final: we'll re-evaluate after one week of nightly runs. If fallback_count > 5 or p95 delta > 20% on any kernel, we escalate to the SRE on-call and open a regression rollback runbook.
Carlos (eng-ml): Uploaded initial PR draft and linked the promptset + example logs in the tracker: https://redwood/pr/quant-fallback-tests
Mei (eng-sre): Sounds good. I'll schedule the drill and add the runbook steps to the wiki.
Ava (eng-ml): Thanks all. Quick Monday check-in to confirm PR merges and status of nightly runs.
